Gateway hosting is configurable across environments: command deadlines, connection/session/upload/pairing capacities, authentication windows, runtime leases, telemetry HTTP policy, computer/browser/desktop executables and resources, and HTTPS/SSH extension sources. `print-default-config`, `check-config` and `export-computer-resources` support operator-owned deployment. A complete configuration reference is included in the source.

Telemetry endpoint changes and browser-proxy registration are restricted to the local operator; collector bearer environment names require a dedicated, non-reserved MOBIUS_ namespace. Resource roots and execution helpers are canonicalized and excluded from writable/protected state. Installer proxy/CA forwarding is explicit, with a restricted PATH. Root Chromium requires an explicit sandbox policy and otherwise returns a clear error.

Requires Core 0.16.10 and Rust 1.99.0; protocol 90 and configuration version 26 remain. New sections default when omitted. The built-in mobius Bot identity remains fixed. Remove legacy `runtime.hold_socket` and `MOBIUS_GATEWAY_SANDBOX_PROC`; select `[execution] procfs_mode = "empty"` explicitly for hosts that already supply PID isolation. Hosted operators must explicitly configure access-lease enforcement and grace. Cloud decides user-upload admission through telemetry; screenshots and artifacts remain available.
